finalText:
**Found the leak in the order worker, fixed it.**

`processOrder` grabbed a connection, awaited the work, then released. When an order threw, that release line never ran, so the connection was gone for good.

The worker log matches exactly. Every `invalid order payload` bumps `pool in-use` by one and it never drops. Five bad orders, five connections, pool dead at 02:06:30. The API and web side never leaked — they already used the safe wrapper.

The fix routes `processOrder` through the same `withConnection` wrapper, which releases in a `finally`.

All 4 tests pass, 68ms.

Worth a follow-up: the pool has no reclaim or timeout, so any future missed release is permanent again.
